class.name: OcgMessageExecstatus
class.brief_description: Tiny class for extended handling of error / execution status of algorithm in universal way.
class.description: /** * Tiny class for extended handling of error / execution * status of algorithm in universal way. * * It is in fact a set of integers represented as a collection of bit flags * for each of four types of status; each status flag has its own symbolic * name and can be set/tested individually. * * The flags are grouped in semantic groups: * - No flags means nothing done * - Done flags correspond to some operation successfully completed * - Warning flags correspond to warning messages on some * potentially wrong situation, not harming algorithm execution * - Alarm flags correspond to more severe warnings about incorrect * user data, while not breaking algorithm execution * - Fail flags correspond to cases when algorithm failed to complete */

method.name: IsDone
method.description: Check if at least one status of each type is set

method.name: SetAllDone
method.description: Set all statuses of each type

method.name: ClearAllDone
method.description: Clear all statuses of each type

method.name: Add
method.description: Add statuses to me from theOther execution status

method.name: And
method.description: Leave only the statuses common with theOther

method.name: StatusIndex
method.description: Returns index of status in whole range [FirstStatus, LastStatus]

method.name: LocalStatusIndex
method.description: Returns index of status inside type of status (Done or Warn or, etc) in range [1, StatusesPerType]

method.name: TypeOfStatus
method.description: Returns status type (DONE, WARN, ALARM, or FAIL)

method.name: StatusByIndex
method.description: Returns status with index theIndex in whole range [FirstStatus, LastStatus]
